name: Nerkeli
city: Feria del Milenio, Sid Nalta, Khol Moshin
backstory: An old childhood friend of Nuvilo. Raised in Terfila, he decided young to become a pilot and see the world - airplanes are his passion. Good sense of humor, with a running theory that ducks are the most likely descendants of the legendary Daax. At the Feria del Milenio helping run the airplane showcase. Flies the M7 corridor (Puente Intercontinental - Nvhi) regularly, reaching Nvhi's edge - though until catching up with Nuvilo at the fair, he'd never once connected the place to his old friend's family. Per the Luminacion Register, also flies a Sid Nalta-Terfila route, and has a separate instance stationed at Khol Moshin.

experience: Is minding the Feria del Milenio's airplane hangar exhibit for the fair's showcase; old childhood friend of Nuvilo.
Has a running, self-aware joke theory that ducks are the last living descendants of the Daax.
Flies the M7 corridor (Puente Intercontinental -> Nvhi) regularly, reaching Nvhi's edge.
Picked up from Nuvilo in this conversation: that Nuvilo's family claims descent from 'Navalius,' said to have founded Nvhi - new to Nerkeli despite flying past the place often.
Flies M7 as an assigned freight/passenger run, not personal business - carries tools, building supplies, mail, and occasional fragile merchant goods.
Openly skeptical of the Feria's 'thousand years of Milkantis' framing - says he's heard the world's starting point told three incompatible ways across his travels.
